slide_3_variant_view.title: Variant View: Grid Resilience is the Real Energy Security Trade

quotes.quote: Momentum divergence: Dongfang net profit grew 31% on 13% revenue growth, while Jereh net profit grew only 2% on 21% revenue growth.
Policy divergence: Dongfang benefits from China's grid infrastructure investment boom; Jereh remains exposed to volatile oil and gas cycles and transition pressure.

slide_4_industry_outlook.title: Electricity Continuity is Becoming Strategic Infrastructure

quotes.quote: Dongfang's 2025 business focus includes grid infrastructure and transmission, State Grid contracts, new-type power system development, and source-grid-load-storage integration.
Sector rotation favors grid infrastructure over oilfield services as the energy transition shifts the bottleneck from fuel supply to electricity-system integration.

slide_5_long_case.title: Dongfang Electric: Direct Beneficiary of Grid Hardening

quotes.quote: Dongfang reported 2025 revenue of RMB 78.62bn, up 12.8%, and net profit of RMB 3.831bn, up 31.11%, showing profit growth ahead of revenue growth.
Key Dongfang strengths include margin expansion, positioning in China's grid infrastructure buildout, State Grid investment exposure, and nuclear and wind equipment leadership.

slide_7_short_case.title: Yantai Jereh: Exposed to Fragile Energy Logistics

quotes.quote: Jereh's net profit growth of 2% lagged its 21% revenue growth, indicating margin compression rather than clean operating leverage.
Jereh risks include customer concentration, cyclical oil and gas price dependency, geopolitical export risk, technology obsolescence, and profit margin pressure.
Jereh remains centered on oilfield services and equipment, shale gas completion tools, and oilfield pressure pumping equipment.

slide_8_short_upside.title: Higher Oil Prices Do Not Guarantee Service Earnings

quotes.quote: Jereh trades at 46.48x P/E and 5.55x P/B, a richer valuation than Dongfang despite weaker 2025 profit growth.
Jereh's strong cash flow may not be sustainable if margin pressure persists and revenue growth continues to outpace profit growth.

slide_10_ai_module.title: AI Signal Tracker: Capex Language Moving to Grid
